curation_note: Structure preserves AND (all) / OR (any), ranges and required versus preferred. Leaves: years_in_families (reviewed roles in the named role families, from partial dates: 'meets' only when the certain minimum reaches the stated minimum, 'does not meet' only when the possible maximum cannot), product_exposure (confirmed, categorised responsibility evidence in a role of the named families showing a product-ownership area; a job title alone never counts), current_role_in_families and not_transitioning_from (the user's CURRENT confirmed role only; earlier roles never trigger an exclusion), total_years, qualification (an 'or equivalent' clause never gives 'does not meet'; a missing qualification record is unclear, never absence), and stated_condition (a condition the profile cannot show, such as a product domain; always unclear). Preferred criteria are reported but never decide the outcome. Revision v2 (D36): product management tenure leaves list Product Owner and founder families as possible equivalents, which give Unclear (never meets or does not meet on their own); qualifications match the stated field on normalised whole values through explicit aliases, or a degree type (B.E./B.Tech); internships, part-time work and apprenticeships with an unspecified work pattern never count towards the certain minimum.
